items.name: Bacolod Speedcubing Open 2017

venue.name: CityMall Mandalagan
venue.address: CityMall Mandalagan, Lacson St, Bacolod, Negros Occidental

items.information: The competition is open to all interested cubers. This is the third speedcubing competition in the island of Negros. Payment details are emailed within 7days once pre-registration is complete. Kindly follow the instructions as emailed. When doing pre-registration, be sure to accurately list your list of guests.

items.name: Tambov Summer 2017
items.information:
Registration will be closed at midnight on July, 26.
There is a limit of 100 competitors for this competition.
Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. 
Registration fee:
* 300 RUB (or 200 RUB using on-line prepayment); 
Please contact to main organizer for prepayment info.
If you do not see your name on the compeitors table after 48 hours of registering, please contact us to resolve the issue.
Visit the competition website for more details.
